summary: A preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) filed by NVIDIA Corp for a public offering of multiple series of senior unsecured notes (2028-2056 maturities). No specific price, coupon, or size disclosed—terms will be set at pricing. The notes rank equally with existing senior debt, are redeemable at NVIDIA's option, and will not be listed on any exchange. Proceeds likely for general corporate purposes. This is a standard debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
